title: The Evaluation Context Protocol (ECP): A Portable Contract for AI Agent Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The evolution of artificial intelligence has necessitated a fundamental shift from evaluating isolated Large Language Models (LLMs) to assessing autonomous agentic architectures. This paper explores the critical methodologies for evaluating AI agents and the essential role of advanced observability infrastructure. We analyze the architectural components of agents and identify the severe limitations of current evaluation paradigms, including benchmark exploitation, the "confidently wrong" phenomenon, and the discrepancy between theoretical capability and operational reliability. To begin addressing the fragmentation in current evaluation infrastructure, this paper proposes the Evaluation Context Protocol (ECP), an early-stage, vendor-neutral framework intended to act as a portable evaluation contract layer for agentic systems. translated_title: 评估上下文协议（ECP）：AI代理评估的可移植契约
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19263v1 公告类型：新 摘要：人工智能的演变已促使从评估孤立的大型语言模型（LLMs）转向评估自主代理架构的根本性转变。本文探讨了评估AI代理的关键方法以及高级可观测性基础设施的重要作用。我们分析了代理的架构组件，并识别了当前评估范式的严重局限性，包括基准利用、“自信错误”现象以及理论能力与操作可靠性之间的差距。为了开始解决当前评估基础设施的碎片化问题，本文提出了评估上下文协议（ECP），这是一个早期阶段的、供应商中立的框架，旨在作为代理系统的可移植评估契约层。在当前形式下，ECP定义了一个小型JSON-RPC接口，代理通过该接口暴露其用户可见的输出。
tldr: 本文提出评估上下文协议（ECP），一个早期、供应商中立的JSON-RPC接口框架，旨在为AI代理系统提供可移植的评估契约层，以解决当前评估范式的碎片化和局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Evaluation Context Protocol (ECP), an early-stage, vendor-neutral JSON-RPC interface framework designed to serve as a portable evaluation contract layer for AI agent systems, addressing fragmentation and limitations in current evaluation paradigms.
